representation_fit.evidence: Brief asks create × spatial-workspace with canvas_object and '落位即意图'. Implementation is a 960×600 room canvas (styles.css:70-81) where physical placement encodes intent: semantic zones 窗边采光带/储物区/休闲区 (prefer) and a hatched keep-clear 动线通道 (data.js:22-27), 8 placeable object types with sizes (data.js:9-18), 10 initial placed objects (data.js:30-41), conflict/zone semantics (app.js:43-60). Both screenshots show exactly this shape; creation verbs (stamp, drag-in, N-key) at app.js:236-277.

primary_task_salience.evidence: 1280x860.png / 1440x900.png: the placement canvas dominates ~60% of the initial screen and is already populated; left palette offers the 8 create types with '按 1-8 选类型，N 快速放置' (index.html:25); status bar leads with placement/selection verbs (app.js:220, 564).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy, not human. Header subtitle states the job ('空间排布画板 · 落位即意图', index.html:12); inspector empty-state explains the goal in one sentence ('把物品放进对应区域…避开红色动线通道', index.html:44); zone labels carry their own hints on canvas (data.js:23-26, visible in both screenshots); status bar gives the first action (Tab select, arrows move, ? help). What/where is conveyed without any exploration.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation: single screen, primary objects (canvas_object instances) visible and manipulable at load in both screenshots; selection via click or Tab cycle (app.js:283-292, 488); creation reachable in one step (1-8 + N, app.js:493, 504-508). No routes or hidden modes; help is an overlay (index.html:76).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions occur in place on the one screen (index.html:21-69); inspector and status update in situ (app.js:157-187, 204-214); the only full-screen surface is the dismissible help overlay preserving state (app.js:460-463, Esc closes at 455-459); no routing/navigation APIs anywhere in source; undo/redo preserves history (app.js:63-84).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly what the job needs: topbar with 3 buttons + count chip, 8-item palette, canvas, inspector (whose empty state doubles as a useful zone tally), 1-line status bar (index.html:11-74; both screenshots). No redundant panels, tabs, or decorative controls; inspector object panel appears only when needed (hidden attr, index.html:46).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt (measurement-summary.json): a11y.target_size pass, a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order skipped. Strong keyboard a11y — complete key map incl. arrow move, R rotate, [/] z-order, Tab cycle, N place, Del, precise X/Y inputs (app.js:465-510, 525-539; help table index.html:83-107) and input focus styling (styles.css:137). But contrast tokens fail AA: #94a3b8 tips/labels on white (styles.css:66-67, 159), zone-hint 10px at opacity .8 (styles.css:91); canvas objects are non-focusable divs relying on a global keydown handler (app.js:102-132, 465) with no role/tabindex/aria-selected, and status narration is visual-only (app.js:204-209, no aria-live).

frontend_rework.evidence: Receipt: 3 of 7 checks fail (layout.overflow, a11y.contrast, type.min_projected_size). Visible defect: at 1280x860 the fixed 960×600 room + 22px stage padding (styles.css:69-71) exceeds the ~864px stage between the 176px palette and 240px inspector, clipping the room's right edge in 1280x860.png (no right border; it fits only at 1440x900). Initial 龟背竹 plant partially occludes the 窗边采光带 hint text (1280x860.png, window zone). min_projected_size consistent with 10px object labels (styles.css:114) and the 20px-tall board type (data.js:16).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '空间操作有键盘等价物' is exhaustively implemented, not just claimed: arrow-key move w/ Shift fine-step (app.js:486-492), N auto-place (493, 263-277), 1-8 type arm (504-508), R/Shift+R rotate with AABB swap (494-495, 302-316), [/] z-order (499-500), Tab/Shift+Tab cycle (488), Del delete (497), Ctrl+Z/Y undo-redo (481-482), precise X/Y coordinate entry (app.js:525-539); dedicated help overlay titled '所有空间操作均有键盘等价物' (index.html:76-109) and inline reminders (index.html:44, 80).

scores.overall_note: The package matches its brief almost exactly: a single-screen spatial canvas where physical placement is the intent (prefer-zones plus a keep-clear aisle, data.js:22-27), the canvas_object is reachable with zero navigation, and the acceptance seed — keyboard equivalents for every spatial operation — is implemented comprehensively (app.js:465-539) and surfaced in a help overlay (index.html:76-109). Initial screen is self-explanatory and pre-populated with a correct no-conflict exemplar arrangement (冲突物品 0 件 in both screenshots). The weaknesses are finish quality, not concept: 3 of 7 receipt checks fail — the fixed-size room clips at 1280 width, several 10px/#94a3b8 text tokens fail contrast and projected-size minimums — and the a11y.focus_order check was skipped, so keyboard focus semantics rest on source inspection, where objects are non-focusable divs. Accessibility scored 3 and frontend rework 2 on that basis. Scores for understanding, salience, and navigation are model-judged proxies from the screenshots and source; no human study exists in this pilot, so human preference, task time, and retrieval accuracy are marked not observable, per rubric.
